subject: Error with duplicate column names with unite()

messages.author: 9c69ed22aa4df507
messages.subject: Error with duplicate column names with unite()
parts:
Hi,

I encountered a problem with duplicated column names when using the unite() to merge across samples (also with save.db=FALSE). I have a set of 63 bismarkCoverage files I uploaded  with methRead using the dbtype="tabix". All steps up to here succeeded without a error. When I run the example data distributed with methylKit I have no problems with unite. The input file in my dp looks like this:

CM003709.1    1035    1035    *    22    2    20
CM003709.1    1059    1059    *    22    0    22
CM003709.1    1071    1071    *    78    20    58
CM003709.1    1095    1095    *    101    2    99
CM003709.1    1119    1119    *    23    0    23
CM003709.1    1181    1181    *    22    17    5
CM003709.1    1182    1182    *    21    1    20
CM003709.1    1192    1192    *    22    18    4
CM003709.1    1193    1193    *    16    11    5
CM003709.1    1202    1202    *    22    18    4
...

Here is a recap of my steps:

> meth_trtAll=unite(myobj_trtAll, destrand=FALSE, save.db=TRUE)
Error in merge.data.table(res, tmp, by = c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4"), all = all) :
  x has some duplicated column name(s): V5.x,V6.x,V7.x,V5.y,V6.y,V7.y. Please remove or rename the duplicate(s) and try again.
> traceback()
10: stop("x has some duplicated column name(s): ", paste(names(x)[duplicated(names(x))],
        collapse = ","), ". Please remove or rename the duplicate(s) and try again.")
9: merge.data.table(res, tmp, by = c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4"), all = all)
8: merge(res, tmp, by = c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4"), all = all)
7: merge(res, tmp, by = c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4"), all = all)
6: FUN(X[[i]], ...)
5: lapply(X = X, FUN = FUN, ...)
4: mclapply(chrs, mergeTbxByChr, tabixList, dir, filename, parallel = FALSE,
       all = all, mc.cores = mc.cores)
3: mergeTabix(tabixList = objList, dir = dir, filename = filename,
       mc.cores = mc.cores)
2: unite(myobj_trtAll, destrand = FALSE, save.db = TRUE)
1: unite(myobj_trtAll, destrand = FALSE, save.db = TRUE)
